---
title: Templates
description: Groundwork's starting points for a new app, CLI, terminal menu, desktop app, phone app, Omarchy panel or report, each running here or on your machine as a demo.
---

Each template in [`templates/`](https://github.com/timmo001/groundwork/tree/main/templates) is a working setup to start a new project from, and a demo of Groundwork on fixture or made-up data. Copy one, swap the sample data for your own, and keep the setup.

<PageCards paths={["/templates/app", "/templates/report"]} />

| Template | Starts | Demo |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`cli-tool`](https://github.com/timmo001/groundwork/tree/main/templates/cli-tool) | A CLI with the [agent surface](/behavior#agents) | `mise run demo:cli -- status`, the [demo app](/templates/app)'s CLI target |
| [`tui-menu`](https://github.com/timmo001/groundwork/tree/main/templates/tui-menu) | A terminal menu app on the [terminal components](/terminal) | `mise run demo:tui` |
| [`desktop-app`](https://github.com/timmo001/groundwork/tree/main/templates/desktop-app) | A [desktop app](/desktop) in an Electrobun window | `mise run demo:desktop` |
| [`pwa-app`](https://github.com/timmo001/groundwork/tree/main/templates/pwa-app) | A web app [installable on phones](/phones) | `mise run demo:pwa` |
| [`omarchy-panel`](https://github.com/timmo001/groundwork/tree/main/templates/omarchy-panel) | An Omarchy bar button and panel | `mise run demo:panel` |
| [`report`](https://github.com/timmo001/groundwork/tree/main/templates/report) | A [report](/reports) a tool writes | [Report](/templates/report), embedded |
